status: Working result with scoped independent local review. Formal review pending.

preparation.units: Forces divided by participating mass throughput. Unit constituent mass, center spring stiffness and lever, and unit feed residence time. Held gain c=-F_act/(mass rate times U) at V=W=0 and drag g=F_act/(mass rate times V) at U=W=0. U incoming, V prescribed rim velocity, W local velocity of a separately supported material degree of freedom. Fixed throughput per representative patch, no bare center mass or free acceleration inferred.
preparation.residence: Same independent decision hazard 1/128 and registration hazard 1/256 across all preparations, steady injection of initially unstretched material. One third of departures have registered before the decision. Registration ends at the decision even if center springs remain attached. The remaining portion of a full spring cycle is a new local release law. Extra translation-only inventory is allowed with no crowding or feedback on intake, phase or angular registration.
preparation.work_and_ownership: The unloading anchor moves at (1-h)V+hW; the conjugate forces have weights (1-h,h). At switching both extension and parcel velocity are continuous with no impulse or work by the ideal switch. Count release spring energy as outgoing internal energy or heat once. Do not identify external support reactions as mouth force. A receiving-side coupling needs a physical support or a projected normal load to be compatible with a shear-free bulk. W is independently specified and not identified with a distant bulk velocity.
preparation.analytic: A=E[1-cos(omega a)] and B=E[unload*(1-cos(omega a))], where a is decision age. The complementary-phase tail yields c=A-B+hB and g=A-B+h²B, and A*g-c²=B(A-B)(1-h)². Full or partial return is an assumption; the calculation also tests release pi/6 beyond precise recovery. The smallest available sideways power over U at fixed V in the more general passive budget is mass rate times (g-c²/2)V².
preparation.energy_scope: Stationary independently supported receiver, steady motion, no draw on stored or radial flow/pressure energy, cold uniform incoming sideways speed, actuator the sole other power input, nonnegative outgoing sideways kinetic energy plus heat. The four reversals give (P(U,V)-P(U,-V)-P(-U,V)+P(-U,-V))/4=-mass rate*c*U*V for the actuator. This restriction does not apply to the full open drain without its full incremental power budget or to two independently moving supports. No physical force, radius scaling or charge readout measured.

review.verdict: Scoped clear for the steady parcel momentum and energy balances, the held and tow coefficients, and their dependence on the independently moving receiving support in the prescribed release law. The physical release timing, support motion, and whole-mouth free fall remain open.
review.method: Fresh local reviewer derived cohort weights and mean slopes from the two competing clocks, independently rotated each parcel through both stages, tested work per parcel and compared independent port drives including common boosts. Author also used symbolic algebra and a separate finite-age quadrature.
review.report_verdict: Scoped clear for the report’s stationary-support held and tow gains, reversible-release timing control, four-reversal power identity, and conditional one-stream energy bound.
